title: Hinomori Shiho — The Right Path For Me〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We've all gotten pretty used to doing shows now...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Unlike before, the crowd's staying with us through our original songs too.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That means I should spice things up too.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna go chat with the manager for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The crowd seemed to like our original song, didn't they?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, but if we were to ask if they all got into it...
Hm? Is it just you, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh? Iori?
Wait, did you come here to see the show?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I came partway through and just managed to catch your performance. You've all improved a lot since I last heard you play.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I really liked how you chose to play a mellow song so that it'd be easier for the band after yours to add some depth to their performance. You clearly put some thought into this event as a whole.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We came up with that together. Well, to be fair, I sort of memorized that band's set list because they play here so often, so I did mention that to them.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Well, anyway...
Since we got this chance to talk, here, have this...

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Today's show ended up being pretty good even though STANDOUT wasn't here.

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line: Yeah. I know they're getting ready for their big debut and can't perform for a while, but I've been seeing a lot of lackluster shows lately...

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: But I think we finally have some candidate bands that can take up their mantle. They played today, uh... Leo/need? I've gotta think the manager's feeling pretty relieved too.

rows.Speaker: Regular A's Voice
rows.Line: Seeing kids like them play the way they do has gotta get anyone excited regardless of their age.

rows.Speaker: Regular B's Voice
rows.Line: Yeah, still... I don't really get their music. Maybe a part of me is having trouble understanding how kids these days write songs...

rows.Speaker: Regular A's Voice
rows.Line:
No, I sorta understand what you mean...
I can't help but compare them to STANDOUT because I like them so much...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: They say that they like our music now, but I remember being told all sorts of nasty stuff around the time we started doing shows, like the lyrics not making sense or the melody's terrible...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, so you shouldn't listen to them. More importantly, here...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: The cover art's still not finished, but this is STANDOUT's big debut single.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah. I originally came here today to go around to everyone that was there for us along the way, like the manager, and hand these out.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: And I sorta owe you for playing in Mio's place, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I didn't mean for it to be a favor.
Plus, you gave Ichika some advice about singing, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You refused my offer and decided to try and go pro with your own band.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: So, I wanna see what you girls are really made of.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. We know full well what we're up against.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Alright, I need to talk to the manager, so give the others my regards.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I refused her offer, huh?
Come to think of it, I started getting a lot of looks after I did that...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I didn't realize it at the time, but I guess some rumors were going around about how Iori was looking for a new bassist...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Then, she chose me, I turned her down and word probably got out. That might explain why it felt like I had a target on my back...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, wait... I still need to see the manager...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's like they're amazing no matter how many times I hear them play. If anything, they've only gotten better at expressing themselves through their music...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The manager even said so the other day...
Everybody's talking about how STANDOUT's songs are great because they sound so trendy and have these powerful beats...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But their true greatness lies in the way they express themselves through their music and have the technical mastery to match.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is what it means to be a professional band...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And as obvious as this may sound, other bands out there are practicing and honing their craft just like us...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You refused my offer and decided to try and go pro with your own band.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: So, I wanna see what you girls are really made of.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What we're really made of, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (You need more than just commitment to become a professional musician.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I have a feeling it's the reason why she went out of her way to tell me that.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In simple terms, I think she just wants to see us produce some real results...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, hello. I was thinking about working on some stuff on my own.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see.
In that case, we shouldn't be interrupt... Wah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think I just kicked something by accident... Where did it go?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's round.
And I think it's glowing...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Where am I...?
It looks like a city...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hang on... Untitled is still playing...
Does that mean I'm still in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But no matter how many times I tell it to, I can't get Untitled to stop.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, I remember Luka trying to tell me something.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That round thing... Did touching it cause all this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see some buildings in the distance, but this doesn't look like any part of Shibuya I'm familiar with...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And there's no use in just standing around. I'll start by taking a quick look around...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? A fork in the road...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's a sign by the street going to the right... Um... “Right”...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does it really need to tell me that “right” is “right”...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, it could mean that it's the “correct choice” instead of which direction I'm going...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That street seems nicer with more people and buildings along the way.)
